text:
Maya: FYI — LumenPay (mid-market) shows a sharp activation velocity drop in week 2: 0.2 events/user vs 0.9 baseline. Risking churn if we don't unblock.
Arjun: I saw that metric. Any onboarding errors in logs?
Onboarding-Bot: System: 502 on /import endpoint between 03:40-03:52 UTC — 3 failures (user payloads).
Maya: Ok. Proposal: immediate outreach + short remediation play. Micro-plan: 1) 15-min troubleshooting call within 24h, 2) apply a one-time credit as goodwill, 3) schedule an enablement walkthrough with the PM. Also block auto-downgrade for 72h.
Jess: I can own outreach. Need a concise template. I also support the 72h hold. Can we surface an in-app checklist nudge for the next import attempt?
Sam (CSM): Add 'feature tour + checklist' email to the play. I'll pause downgrade via admin and add follow-ups at +24h and +72h. @Arjun can you link the import failures to an incident and flag for engineering triage?
Arjun: Tagged incident #inc-4521 and pushed the import payload samples to the incident. Quick signal: payload sizes ~4x normal, causing upstream timeout. I'll raise a temporary timeout increase and patch the validation.
Jess: Outreach draft (short): "Hi LumenPay — we detected an import glitch affecting a few customers. Sorry for the hiccup. Would you join a 15-min call to help complete your import? We've paused any downgrade and will credit next month. Pick a slot: <cal link>" Thoughts?
Maya: Good. Also add a CRM checkbox: 'onboarding friction: import' so we tag in churn analytics and help categorize root causes.
Sam (CSM): Done — CRM flag added and task created for post-call notes. Scheduling reminders set. :thumbsup:
Jess: Sending outreach now, will update thread after the call.
Maya: Thanks — once call complete, capture: blocker, workaround used, promised credit, and next steps. We'll fold into the mid-segment churn playbook as a new microflow.
